name: budget-notes
description: Extension that enhances Lunch Money budget view with notes and itemized breakdowns

scripts.build:chrome: TARGET=chrome node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && TARGET=chrome vite build
scripts.build:firefox: TARGET=firefox node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && TARGET=firefox vite build
scripts.build:safari: TARGET=safari node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && TARGET=safari vite build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:safari
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node scripts/package-zip.mjs chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/package-zip.mjs firefox
